question: What kind of practitioner becomes a mockery of the Kula scriptures?
premises: A seeker motivated by greed is described
Such a person is fickle and constant in that fickleness
This behavior mocks the Kula scriptures
inference: One who seeks out of greed and remains fickle is a mockery of the Kula scriptures
uncertainties: The gender shift in capalā may indicate a specific referent or be general
plain_english: One who seeks out of greed and is always fickle is a mockery of the Kula scriptures.
